description.en: The village project with Mr Tyson: oaks cut down in the wood, their trunks for timber, thick walls dug into the slope, heavy oak beams, a floor upstairs and the byre downstairs, a ramp of earth up to the cart door, and the first dry hay in with the pitchfork.
description.sl: Vaški projekt z gospodom Tysonom: hrasti, posekani v gozdu, njihova debla za les, debeli zidovi, vkopani v pobočje, težki hrastovi trami, pod zgoraj in hlev spodaj, klanec iz zemlje do vrat za vozove in prvo suho seno, spravljeno z vilami.
description.it: Il progetto del paese con il signor Tyson: le querce abbattute nel bosco, i tronchi per il legname, muri spessi scavati nel pendio, travi di quercia pesanti, un pavimento di sopra e la stalla di sotto, una rampa di terra fino alla porta dei carri, e il primo fieno asciutto portato dentro con il forcone.
description.de: Das Dorfprojekt mit Herrn Tyson: Eichen im Wald gefällt, ihre Stämme fürs Bauholz, dicke Mauern in den Hang gegraben, schwere Eichenbalken, oben ein Boden und unten der Stall, eine Rampe aus Erde bis zum Wagentor, und das erste trockene Heu mit der Heugabel hinein.

words.example_en: They cut down two old oaks.
words.example_de: Sie haben zwei alte Eichen gefällt.
words.note: Cut down a tree: it falls. Cut, cut, cut: the past is the same.
words.note_sl: Cut down a tree: posekati drevo, da pade. Cut, cut, cut: pretekli čas je enak.
words.note_it: Cut down a tree: abbattere un albero. Cut, cut, cut: il passato è uguale.
words.note_de: Cut down a tree: einen Baum fällen. Cut, cut, cut: die Vergangenheit ist gleich.

words.example_en: The oak has a thick trunk.
words.example_it: La quercia ha un tronco spesso.
words.example_de: Die Eiche hat einen dicken Stamm.
words.note: A tree's trunk, an elephant's trunk, and an old trunk: a big box for clothes.
words.note_sl: A tree's trunk (deblo), an elephant's trunk (rilec) in an old trunk: velika skrinja za obleke.
words.note_it: A tree's trunk (il tronco), an elephant's trunk (la proboscide) e an old trunk: un baule per i vestiti.
words.note_de: A tree's trunk (der Stamm), an elephant's trunk (der Rüssel) und an old trunk: eine große Truhe für Kleider.

words.example_en: The barn is built into the slope.
words.example_it: Il fienile è costruito nel pendio.
words.example_de: Die Scheune ist in den Hang gebaut.
words.note: A slope goes up or down. A bank is a slope too: a bank barn is built into one.
words.note_sl: Slope gre navzgor ali navzdol. Tudi bank je pobočje: bank barn je vkopan vanj.
words.note_it: Uno slope sale o scende. Anche un bank è un pendio: il bank barn ci è costruito dentro.
words.note_de: Ein slope geht hinauf oder hinunter. Auch eine bank ist ein Hang: die bank barn ist hineingebaut.

words.note: Thick walls, a thick book; the opposite is thin. Thick walls keep a barn warm in winter.
words.note_sl: Thick walls, a thick book; nasprotje je thin. Debeli zidovi skedenj pozimi grejejo.
words.note_it: Thick walls, a thick book; il contrario è thin. I muri spessi tengono caldo il fienile d'inverno.
words.note_de: Thick walls, a thick book; das Gegenteil ist thin. Dicke Mauern halten die Scheune im Winter warm.

words.example_en: Six men lift the oak beam.
words.example_it: Sei uomini sollevano la trave di quercia.
words.note: A beam is a long, heavy piece of wood under a floor or a roof. A beam of light is a ray of it.
words.note_sl: Beam je dolg, težek kos lesa pod podom ali streho. A beam of light je svetlobni žarek.
words.note_it: Un beam è un pezzo di legno lungo e pesante sotto un pavimento o un tetto. A beam of light è un raggio di luce.
words.note_de: Ein beam ist ein langes, schweres Stück Holz unter einem Boden oder Dach. A beam of light ist ein Lichtstrahl.

words.note: Heavy, heavier, the heaviest. The opposite is light.
words.note_sl: Heavy, heavier, the heaviest. Nasprotje je light (lahek).
words.note_it: Heavy, heavier, the heaviest. Il contrario è light (leggero).
words.note_de: Heavy, heavier, the heaviest. Das Gegenteil ist light (leicht).

words.note: Upstairs: on the upper floor. Go upstairs, with no to.
words.note_sl: Upstairs: v zgornjem nadstropju. Go upstairs, brez to.
words.note_it: Upstairs: al piano di sopra. Go upstairs, senza to.
words.note_de: Upstairs: im oberen Stock. Go upstairs, ohne to.

words.example_en: The sheep are downstairs, warm and dry.
words.example_sl: Ovce so spodaj, na toplem in suhem.
words.example_it: Le pecore sono di sotto, al caldo e all'asciutto.
words.example_de: Die Schafe sind unten, warm und trocken.
words.note: Downstairs: on the lower floor. Come downstairs, with no to.
words.note_sl: Downstairs: v spodnjem nadstropju. Come downstairs, brez to.
words.note_it: Downstairs: al piano di sotto. Come downstairs, senza to.
words.note_de: Downstairs: im unteren Stock. Come downstairs, ohne to.

words.example_en: The cart goes up the ramp.
words.example_de: Der Wagen fährt die Rampe hinauf.
words.note: A ramp is a slope you can drive up, not stairs. The bank barn's ramp is made of earth.
words.note_sl: Ramp je klanec, po katerem lahko zapelješ, namesto stopnic. Klanec skednja v bregu je iz zemlje.
words.note_it: Una ramp è un pendio su cui si può salire con il carro, invece delle scale. La rampa del fienile è di terra.
words.note_de: Eine ramp ist eine Schräge, die man hinauffahren kann, statt Treppen. Die Rampe der Hangscheune ist aus Erde.

words.example_en: They make the ramp of earth and stones.
words.example_sl: Klanec naredijo iz zemlje in kamenja.
words.example_it: Fanno la rampa di terra e pietre.
words.example_de: Sie machen die Rampe aus Erde und Steinen.
words.note: Earth is the ground you dig in, and our planet: the Earth. Some earth, a lot of earth.
words.note_sl: Earth je zemlja, v katero kopaš, in naš planet: the Earth. Some earth, a lot of earth.
words.note_it: Earth è la terra in cui scavi, e il nostro pianeta: the Earth. Some earth, a lot of earth.
words.note_de: Earth ist die Erde, in der man gräbt, und unser Planet: the Earth. Some earth, a lot of earth.

words.note: Dry, drier, the driest. Make hay while the sun shines: do it while you can!
words.note_sl: Dry, drier, the driest. Make hay while the sun shines: kuj železo, dokler je vroče!
words.note_it: Dry, drier, the driest. Make hay while the sun shines: battere il ferro finché è caldo!
words.note_de: Dry, drier, the driest. Make hay while the sun shines: das Eisen schmieden, solange es heiß ist!

words.note: A pitchfork has two or three long prongs, for hay. A fork is for your food!
words.note_sl: Pitchfork ima dva ali tri dolge roglje, za seno. Fork so vilice za hrano!
words.note_it: Il pitchfork ha due o tre denti lunghi, per il fieno. La fork è la forchetta per mangiare!
words.note_de: Eine pitchfork hat zwei oder drei lange Zinken, fürs Heu. Eine fork ist die Gabel zum Essen!
